mkdir -p ~/.ssh

[Sat 2026-05-09 06:43 UTC] Append the decoded SSH public key to the authorized_keys file to allow access.

Run this on the server, replacing `PASTE_DECODED_PUBLIC_KEY_HERE` with the decoded `ssh-...` public key (single line):

```sh
printf '%s\n' 'PASTE_DECODED_PUBLIC_KEY_HERE' >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

Recommended (avoid SSH ignoring it due to permissions):

```sh
chmod 700 ~/.ssh
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```
